cohort.aggregation: pooled neuron counts; 95% mouse-cluster bootstrap intervals
cohort.minimum_count_rule: qc_pass and decoder_label=sua and not probe_excluded; no firing-rate or response-test requirement for counting toward minimum
cohort.selection: 90-degree exploratory Q1 and baseline-subtracted Q2: p <0.05 and abs(MI) >0.1; Both is their intersection, including opposite-sign responses

uncertainty.rule: 95% percentile mouse-cluster bootstrap; resample contributing mice with replacement within each region and recompute summed responsive / summed joint-testable counts; fixed session/group inclusion and shared resamples for Q1, Q2 and Both

example_layout: two context rasters; paired raw context/control mean traces below

example_rule.comparison: fixed user-selected VISp4 unit 993; visual cortex; finite baseline-subtracted Q2 p >=0.05 and abs(MI) <0.25; finite session firingRateHz >3; no Q1 restriction; 90-degree event; Q1 may be significant; not evidence of equivalence or absent visual responsiveness
example_rule.responsive: 90-degree Q1 AND baseline-subtracted Q2: each p <0.05 and MI >0.1

example_y_scale: shared raw-Hz limits across both units and both conditions

nonq2_population_mean.selection: visual cortex; finite baseline-subtracted Q2 p and MI, p >=0.05; no example-only MI or firing-rate threshold; inherited QC-passing SUA firingRateHz >1

uncertainty.interpretation: Q2-selected, single-session descriptive variability; not evidence of equivalence, trial SEM or uncertainty across independent mice
uncertainty.quantity: pointwise plus/minus SEM across selected neurons, in Hz

nonq2_population_mean.values: equally weighted condition-baseline-subtracted unit SDFs in Hz

normalization.rule: context SDF minus unit's own clean-context baseline mean (Hz); no SD normalization
normalization.zero_sd_rows: retained with valid baseline-subtracted values; no SD division

parameters.baseline_rule: released full 20 ms bins within each trial's preceding grey interval

population_mean.selection: 90-degree Q1 AND baseline-subtracted Q2: each p <0.05 and MI >0.1

uncertainty.interpretation: response-selected, single-session descriptive variability; not trial SEM or uncertainty across independent mice
uncertainty.quantity: pointwise plus/minus SEM across selected neurons, in Hz

population_mean.values: equally weighted condition-baseline-subtracted unit SDFs in Hz
